review_description: Bought solar for my house in Melton with this mob. The sales rep was very good and seemed to be knowledgeable about the panels and stuff. I was a bit worried about putting down a deposit straight away but he convinced me to do it. I had three quotes and the price these guys offered me was very good for the German system that I was getting. Install took about 4 weeks, thats when they had the approval and it went well. Took some time to get the paperwork to the retailer and origin stuffed us around for a good 5 weeks but the company was very helpful in the whole process and helped us understand why origin take so bloddy long to hook us up to the grid. Overall was a good experience and I would recommend the company as they were fairly quick and helpful and mainly because they were the only ones who told me exactly how much time it would take to get installed and hooked up.
